openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.contract: At least two complete useful entombment methods and admission
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.missing: A bounded authorized mode set; each mode's exact admitted creature categories, defenses and resistance/admission outcomes; body/gear fit, in-place or displaced location, occupied volume, material or magical boundary, structural durability where relevant, support/load and collision behavior. The native card supplies none of these values.
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.minimumRecord: Explicit Imprisonment-owned rules for at least two meaningful methods, with provenance and all geometry/eligibility/admission/barrier fields. Preserve the plural native promise and two placements. Do not substitute a short stun, borrow a comparator mode or infer AC/HP, burial depth, infinite durability, crushing damage or additional component prices.

openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.contract: Per-method persistence, agency, escape and rescue
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.missing: For each method, how Instantaneous initiation produces physical aftermath, continuing magic or another explicitly selected result; exact duration/concentration/ending/dismissal/caster-loss behavior; air, food, water, sleep, awareness, senses, speech/components/actions/concentration and communication; meaningful lawful escape or outside rescue with actual access, tools, checks, costs and release conditions.
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.minimumRecord: A complete source-owned lifecycle/escape contract per mode. Retain real actor needs and elapsed clocks unless a separately authorized rule changes them. Define barriers and inside/outside access so a useful rescue can be traced. No default stasis, one-minute limit, dispel-proof permanence, automatic death, free rest or teleport escape is selected.

openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.contract: Durable interaction and once-only terminal settlement
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.missing: Mode-specific growth/form change and attachments; partial suppression and occupied resumption; injury/zero/Null/death with exact corpse/gear custody; recast, same/different owner and competing-source precedence; physical/magical component loci and finite release/collision settlement.
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.minimumRecord: Name stable source/owner/target/body/item identities and define each relevant transition without duplication, refund, resource reset, stale-target capture, silent soul claim, corpse disappearance or revival of ended effects. Storage/unloading is not in-world ending. Public facts and private release information stay separate. Suppression is not automatically destruction or a new source.

openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.contract: Complete paid useful positive and adverse encounters
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.missing: No paid Imprisonment cast on a source-qualified defended eligible creature, actual failed resistance/admission, useful operation of each selected mode or lawful paid escape/outside rescue is supplied.
openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.minimumRecord: After W01-W03 exist, bind legal class/repertoire/preparation, complete caster/recipient/helper profiles, defenses and actual site/item facts. Record Action/V-S-F, final cost from base26RP, Dissonance/Refrain, Counterspell history, exact admission result, each selected mode in use, needs/clocks, growth and suppression/resumption, zero/death/corpse/gear and competing sources, plus lawful escape/rescue costs. Provide full before/after states, forward/inverse operations and separate semantic checks. Keep authored conditional fixtures labeled; do not claim campaign events or user authorship without evidence.

wholeIdentityGate: At least two useful entombment methods and their complete operation are the native promise itself, not an optional external boundary.
minimumNextAction: Prepare an explicitly sourced/authorized Imprisonment-only operating specification for W01-W03; then provide W04. No unchanged historical replay is requested.
